answer: Sybil heads start as an island: alone, each looks harmless. But the operator must thread them together -- fan funds along shared routes, sync attestation heartbeats, cast coordinated ballots -- and that thread becomes the trap. When one identity is proven malicious, quarantine propagates backward along every thread it touched, freezing the connected cluster until each head is re-cleared alone. Like a garden that composts a blighted plant with all the roots it touched, the economy prunes the farm's coordination graph, not just the leaf. The bigger the farm, the more threads catch fire.
